snippet.title: 13 Nights in the Mortuary | Now Hiring: Night Security Officer
snippet.description:
St. Dymphna Memorial Hospital is NOW HIRING. Peaceful walking patrols! Historic halls! Uniform and master keyring provided upon arrival!

A recruitment video from 1996. Please read the fine print.

Thirteen night shifts at a dying hospital. Every night the generator fails. Every night you go down to fix it. Never open the drawers.

13 Nights in the Mortuary is a first-person survival-horror and investigation game from XYTH Studios. No weapons. No HUD. No pausing. Just a flashlight, a keyring, a notebook, and a building that is falling apart around you.

Play the free demo: https://xyth-studios.itch.io/13-nights-in-the-mortuary-demo
XYTH Studios: https://xythstudios.com
